1.consolidated_definition: Acobardarse. Esto ocurre cuando el gallo recibe puntazos por los nudillos, la parte del frente. Entonces pierde fuerza, se acobarda, se ñangota.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To become cowed or intimidated. This occurs when a rooster receives pecks on the metacarpals, the front part of its legs. Then it loses strength and becomes cowed or crestfallen.
